IC2: - Diagnoses of COPD according to criteria of the American Thoracic Society (ATS), a disease state characterized by the presence of chronic airway obstruction due to chronic bronchitis (cough/ [OR] sputum on most days a week for 3 months in a year for at least two successive years) [OR] and/or emphysema
IC3: - Diagnosis of moderate or severe COPD exacerbation (see "Definitions")
IC4: - FEV1 > 0.8 L [AND] and ability to produce sputum after hypertonic saline production
IC5: - Post bronchodilator FEV1/ [OR] Forced Vital Capacity (FVC) ratio <70 % [AND] and post bronchodilator FEV1< 80% pred.
IC6: - A smoking history of >10 pack years
